title: The billing help article says Network starts with the same 14 day free trial

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20 decision card: Network gets the same trial.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. Checkout applies the trial to every plan, so the article line that said Network is quoted and not started from this page was stale. Copy only.
